subject: Deploy Candidate 01 exact horizontal 8:5 preview geometry
body: Deploy Candidate 01 branch SHA e35f94173f5ba0a784954b3bcdf92e8a49fbadd9 to the local Doré Design resident. Required behavior: retain the original Codrops hover/reverse motion; source cards remain horizontal 8:5; each 2-column x 2-row preview group must be an exact horizontal 8:5 overlay of its four source cards. The preview layer must use the measured card-track bounding rectangle, not the full products viewport. No mosaic, no assemble/release state machine, no living-current layer. Do not alter public homepage.

argv: HTML=$(curl -fsS 'http://127.0.0.1:4310/editor-canvas?page=living-water-candidate-01'); printf '%s' "$HTML" | grep -q 'candidate01-exact-grid-preview-geometry' && printf '%s' "$HTML" | grep -q 'GridToFullPreview 8:5' && ! printf '%s' "$HTML" | grep -q 'dore-mosaic-layer'
